title: Mushishi
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In an imagined Japan between the Edo and Meiji eras, the wandering Mushi Master Ginko travels village to village helping people afflicted by Mushi, primitive ethereal lifeforms most humans cannot see. Each episode is a self-contained, quietly eerie story; Ginko insists Mushi are not evil, only trying to live like everyone else.
life_message: It holds up living humbly alongside nature, seeking understanding rather than mastery or blame.

content.note: Little violence; harm comes from Mushi afflictions (Wikipedia; to verify).
'Short, spooky' creepy fairytales, body-affecting afflictions and deaths (Wikipedia; AniList Eco-Horror, Tragedy).
Ginko constantly smokes Mushi tobacco, a practical repellent (Wikipedia).
Loss, grief and isolation in several stories (AniList Tragedy; to verify).
